summary: Five executed Industrial leases within 8 miles and executed between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 qualified. Effective net $/sf/year were computed per the client convention (annualize face rent, 2.5% annual steps at months 13/25/etc., free rent months at start with zero face, gross expense deduction monthly, subtract TI once, then average to annual). Records excluded failed due to missing term/rent/TI, non-executed status, gross without expenses, zero rent, being outside the date/distance window, publication after the cutoff (S-R3746), or duplication (R5958 vs R2732).
limitations: Undiscounted rent-only convention used; no present-value adjustments.
Assumed free months occur at lease start per instruction; timing within a year is not specified in sources.
Gross expense deduction applied every month, including free months, as directed; actual leases may differ.
R7850 has a later executed amendment (U-R7850-2) published/effective after cutoff; ignored here but could change economics.
R9286 has an unsigned draft update (U-R9286-3) increasing free months; ignored since not executed.
Where fields were null (e.g., term, rent, TI, expenses), eligibility was denied; if later evidence supplies these, results may change.
